name: Stephen
summary: One of the seven chosen to serve the church, full of faith, power and the Holy Ghost, who did great wonders among the people. He was stoned after telling the council he saw Jesus standing at the right hand of God, and he prayed for those who killed him.

key_moments.title: Chosen to Serve
key_moments.description: When some widows were being neglected in the daily sharing, the church chose seven men to look after it. Stephen, a man of faith and the Holy Ghost, was the first one named.

key_moments.title: Accused Before the Council
key_moments.description: Stephen did great wonders among the people, and those who argued with him could not stand against his wisdom. They brought false witnesses against him before the council, and everyone there saw that his face looked like an angel's.

key_moments.title: Stoned Outside the City
key_moments.description: Stephen saw God's glory and Jesus standing at God's right hand, and the crowd threw him out of the city and stoned him. He asked the Lord Jesus to receive his spirit and prayed that this sin would not be held against them.
